Ok, so I actually did the complete opposite of what I just said above :)

For adding the widget to the page example, I needed a template, so I added the option. I used `debounce` with `leading: true, trailing: false` though. It seems more straightforward to me than handling the specifics tagname cases, but I'm open to improvements.

I did not add the `cssClass`/`rootClass` property though, as this can be achieve either by editing the wrapping HTML or the `template.
